constraint_statement: The University sits at the heart of a town-sized settlement with wide roads, clean air, lawns, gardens, houses, and shops.
paraphrase: The built-up area around the University is orderly and service-oriented, not a dense city like Tarbean.
notes: Use for campus outskirts and street width.

constraint_statement: The University is described as having about fifteen buildings that do not resemble each other.
paraphrase: The campus is multi-building and architecturally varied.
notes: Useful for avoiding a tiny four-building campus.

constraint_statement: From Imre, Kvothe travels west to reach the University.
paraphrase: The University lies west of Imre.

constraint_statement: The road crosses the Omethi by an old stone bridge over two hundred feet long and wide enough for two wagons to pass.
paraphrase: Stonebridge is a major, ancient, wagon-wide crossing over the river canyon.

constraint_statement: From the crest of Stonebridge, the Archives can be seen rising over the trees to the west.
paraphrase: The Archives are visually dominant from the bridge approach.

constraint_statement: The Archives are featureless, grey, square, larger than stacked granaries, without windows or decoration, and with one great stone entrance.
paraphrase: The Archives should read as a severe monolithic block.
negative_constraint: No windows; no exterior ornament; do not add multiple public entrances.

constraint_statement: Kvothe has to circle the Archives to locate the entrance.
paraphrase: The entrance is not immediately obvious from his approach side.
negative_constraint: Do not assume the approach road faces the main entrance directly.
notes: Useful when choosing the door-facing elevation.

constraint_statement: The public entry sequence is stone doors into a small antechamber, then inner wooden doors into the main interior.
paraphrase: The Archives have a two-stage threshold rather than a single direct opening into the reading spaces.

constraint_statement: From the antechamber, two double doors lead to TOMES and STACKS, and a smaller door behind the desk is labeled SCRIVS ONLY.
paraphrase: The reception zone branches into public reading, restricted stacks, and staff-only space.

constraint_statement: From the Archives, Hollows is reached by going down and then left; it is the short building with colored windows and two big maples out front.
paraphrase: Hollows lies near the Archives and is visually identifiable from outside.

constraint_statement: Mews has a circular central hub with eight wings radiating outward like a compass rose.
paraphrase: The Mews should be planned as a radial building, not a plain dorm block.
negative_constraint: Do not redesign Mews as a simple rectangle.
notes: One of the clearest University shell descriptions.

constraint_statement: Hollows is simple and square, with stained glass windows depicting Teccam speaking at the mouth of his cave.
paraphrase: Hollows has a compact square form and notable stained glass.

constraint_statement: Mains covers nearly an acre and a half and looks cobbled together from smaller mismatched buildings.
paraphrase: Mains should read as accreted rather than symmetrically designed.
negative_constraint: Do not make Mains neat or uniform.

constraint_statement: Mains is the oldest University building and has grown slowly in all directions, engulfing smaller buildings and courtyards.
paraphrase: Mains is an accreted complex with absorbed spaces.

constraint_statement: Mains has odd turns, dead ends, rambling routes, and shortcut paths through workrooms and lecture halls.
paraphrase: Circulation in Mains is intentionally labyrinthine.
negative_constraint: Do not make Mains internally straightforward.

constraint_statement: At least one courtyard in Mains is completely isolated and can only be accessed by climbing through a window.
paraphrase: Mains contains sealed or awkwardly accessible internal voids.

constraint_statement: A second description of Mews presents it as a grey, three-story, many-windowed building with several wings radiating from a central hub.
paraphrase: Mews is not only radial but also visibly windowed and multi-story.
notes: Supports the compass-rose description with usable scale.

constraint_statement: Non-Arcanum bunks are on the fourth floor of the east wing, farthest from the bathing facilities on the ground floor.
paraphrase: The Mews has wing-specific and floor-specific housing assignments plus ground-floor baths.

constraint_statement: Arcanum students are housed in the west wing of Mews.
quote_excerpt: "Arcanum students were located in the west wing"
paraphrase: The Mews divides student housing by status and wing.

constraint_statement: The Mess is a long, low-roofed building across the lawn from the Mews.
paraphrase: The Mess sits close to Mews with open lawn between them.

constraint_statement: Wilem says the Medica is on the other side of the Archives.
paraphrase: The Medica sits directly beyond or opposite the Archives from that courtyard approach.
notes: One of the strongest campus adjacency clues.

constraint_statement: The Medica is a large, oddly shaped building, like a taller and less rambling version of Mains.
paraphrase: The Medica should feel big and irregular, but more disciplined than Mains.

constraint_statement: The Fishery contains shops for glassblowers, joiners, potters, glaziers, plus a forge and smelt-works.
paraphrase: The Fishery is an industrial complex, not a single narrow workshop.

constraint_statement: Kilvin's workshop is in the Artificery, more commonly called the Fishery.
paraphrase: The books treat Artificery and Fishery as the same larger location or two names for the same complex.
notes: Keep both names linked in prompts.

constraint_statement: Kilvin's workshop is as big as the inside of a granary and holds at least two dozen thick-timbered worktables.
quote_excerpt: "big as the inside of a granary"
paraphrase: The core workshop is broad, open, and heavily bench-filled.

constraint_statement: A narrow wrought-iron stair leads to slim iron walkways about twenty-five feet above the floor among the rafters.
paraphrase: The workshop has elevated maintenance or observation walkways in the rafters.

constraint_statement: The Medica, alchemy complex, and Artificery are major production nodes exporting medicines, alchemical materials, and crafted devices.
paraphrase: These buildings are not decorative; they are working production centers tied to trade.
notes: Useful for city logistics and loading areas.

constraint_statement: The Stocks are the storeroom where artificers sign out tools and materials.
paraphrase: The Fishery includes a formal issue window or materials counter.

constraint_statement: Auri leads Kvothe down through an iron drainage grate into the tunnel sprawl beneath the University.
paraphrase: At least one surface grate connects the campus to the Underthing.

constraint_statement: Named Underthing routes include Nodway, Vaults, and Billows, and one tunnel space is heated by exposed steam pipes.
paraphrase: The Underthing is a large named network rather than a single sewer tunnel.
notes: Useful for later subterranean map work.

constraint_statement: A proper tunnel and a long, belly-crawl passage provide hidden access to the Archives through its ventilation system.
paraphrase: The Archives connect to the Underthing through service or ventilation routes.

constraint_statement: Tomes is a large, high-ceilinged, well-lit main reading room with long tables and shelving for core class texts, and requests are submitted at the desk.
paraphrase: Tomes is a formal public reading room, not a maze like the Stacks.

constraint_statement: During admissions, Tomes is the only well-lit room in the whole Archives building.
paraphrase: Most of the Archives remain dim or dark by comparison.

constraint_statement: The Stacks are unlit; students need hand lamps, and open flame is catastrophically unsafe there.
paraphrase: The Stacks should be planned as dark storage with portable light, not evenly lit halls.
negative_constraint: No windows; no general open-flame lighting.

constraint_statement: Despite having no windows, the Stacks are cool, dry, and fresh-aired.
paraphrase: Any floor plan should account for unseen air management.

constraint_statement: Kvothe describes the Archives as a city unto itself with roads, winding lanes, alleys, and shortcuts.
paraphrase: The Archives should be mapped as a navigable urban maze of book districts.

constraint_statement: Named Archives subareas include the Scriptorium, Sorting Hall, Buggery, Cataloger's Mew, Bindery, Bolts, Palimpsest, and acquisitions office.
paraphrase: These rooms or districts should exist in any serious Archives layout.

constraint_statement: The acquisitions office is tiny and perpetually dark, with one wall dominated by a huge lacquered map tracking cities, roads, and book-acquisition teams.
paraphrase: This office is a distinct, map-heavy administrative room.
notes: Useful for a specific room prompt later.

constraint_statement: The Stacks make up most of the Archives and include well-cataloged and badly cataloged neighborhoods; two whole floors once shifted into disorder after ledger-books burned.
paraphrase: The building is multi-floor and unevenly organized.
notes: Confirms vertical scale and uneven maintenance.

constraint_statement: The four-plate door sits as the secret at the heart of the Archives city.
paraphrase: The four-plate door is a central interior landmark.

constraint_statement: A scriv finds Kvothe near the southeast stairwell in the Stacks.
paraphrase: The Stacks include cardinally identified internal stairwells.

constraint_statement: Masters' Hall is grey stone, and at night a dim interior light shows stained glass of Teccam speaking at the mouth of his cave.
paraphrase: Masters' Hall has a more formal, residential-academic identity than the industrial buildings.

constraint_statement: Masters' Hall contains living quarters for the masters, the resident gillers, and guest rooms for visiting arcanists.
paraphrase: Masters' Hall is primarily residential and administrative.

constraint_statement: The Crucible has countless bristling chimneys and a stone smell of ammonia, charred flowers, acid, and alcohol.
paraphrase: The Crucible should read as a chemical-industrial building.
notes: Possible relation to alchemy complex still unconfirmed.

constraint_statement: Elodin reaches Haven by following a wide dirt road out of the northern edge of the University into the forest.
paraphrase: Haven is outside the dense campus core and approached from the north.

constraint_statement: Haven is a huge manor-like building bigger than the Artificery, with a red tile roof, high windows, arched doorways, pillars, fountains, flowers, and hedges.
paraphrase: Haven is expansive and formal, not a dungeon block.

constraint_statement: Haven is enclosed by a nearly ten-foot-tall wrought-iron fence that is effectively unclimbable.
paraphrase: Haven is deliberately enclosed and secured.

constraint_statement: Haven has a huge entryway with stained glass windows and vaulted ceilings, then a wide marble staircase and long white hallways lined with wooden doors.
paraphrase: Haven interior is polished, large-scale, and vertically organized.

constraint_statement: Kvothe reaches the Mains roof by shimmying up drainpipes in a sheltered box alley.
paraphrase: Mains includes exterior roof-accessible drainpipes and at least one narrow alley box.
notes: Helpful for exterior massing and traversal.

constraint_statement: The isolated Mains courtyard contains an apple tree and is reached from the roof approach.
paraphrase: This likely matches the earlier isolated courtyard rumor, but the text does not explicitly name it the same courtyard.
notes: Mark as likely same courtyard, not fully locked.

constraint_statement: At night the Archives are described as five stories tall, windowless, and lit only by sympathy light leaking around the massive doors.
paraphrase: This confirms the exterior height more explicitly than the earlier monolith description.

constraint_statement: The Archives have a locked roof door and a bare stone rooftop above a courtyard from which people below can hear calls for help.
paraphrase: The Archives roof is accessible by keyed door and overlooks at least one courtyard.
notes: Important for top-floor and roof planning.

constraint_statement: Kvothe tries every inn on this side of the river before taking work and lodging at Anker's, placing it on the University side rather than in Imre.
paraphrase: Anker's belongs on the University bank.

constraint_statement: Kvothe's tiny room at Anker's is on the third floor and can be reached from an alley between the inn and the bakery by climbing rain barrel, ledge, drainpipe, and roofs.
paraphrase: Anker's and the bakery share a climbable alley-and-roof relationship.
notes: Good if you map the student district in detail.

constraint_statement: The Omethi has carved a rocky canyon between Imre and the University approach.
paraphrase: The river crossing is a real terrain break with meaningful elevation and sightline impact.

constraint_statement: Archives entry depends on being recorded in the desk ledgers, or being in the book.
paraphrase: The antechamber desk is a formal gatekeeping checkpoint rather than a passive reception desk.

constraint_statement: Hollows contains a dark theatre-like admissions chamber with a stage and a large raised crescent table for the masters.
paraphrase: At least one major Hollows room is ceremonial and authority-focused rather than classroom-flat.

constraint_statement: Hollows has at least one back entrance and locked interior routes that can be bypassed or picked.
paraphrase: Hollows is not a single-front-door-only building.

constraint_statement: The bursar is reached by crossing a courtyard, entering another stone building, passing through a hallway, and going down a flight of stairs.
paraphrase: The bursar is in a separate administrative building with at least partial below-grade access.
notes: Integrated from evidencNOTW.xlsx. Building remains unnamed.

constraint_statement: The Mess dining room has large plank tables and can seat roughly two hundred students at once.
paraphrase: The Mess is a substantial communal dining hall, not a tiny canteen.

constraint_statement: At least one Mains classroom is arranged like a small theatre with tiered semicircular seating around a raised stage and stone worktable.
paraphrase: Some Mains teaching rooms are demonstration theatres rather than flat classrooms.

constraint_statement: Masters' Hall is a large windowless room with a familiar crescent-shaped masters' table that is not elevated in the same way as the Hollows admissions theatre.
paraphrase: The masters use a second formal chamber distinct from the raised-admissions staging, but its exact relation to Hollows stays unresolved.
notes: Integrated from evidencNOTW.xlsx. Keep as ambiguous siting evidence.

constraint_statement: The Medica treats the sick beyond the student body, and those without coin can work off their debt after recovery.
quote_excerpt: work until your debt is balanced
paraphrase: The Medica is both a teaching/clinical building and a functioning public hospital-economy institution.

constraint_statement: Stacks access is treated separately from Tomes, with a stack fee and a practice of signing out portable hand lamps from the desk.
paraphrase: The Archives threshold differentiates public reading from deeper-stack use through both permission and equipment.

constraint_statement: The Stacks include stairwells going up and down, small stone rooms with heavy wooden doors, and a building profile described as six stories tall with underground extension.
quote_excerpt: six stories tall and also extends underground
paraphrase: The Stacks are vertically extensive and include enclosed study or discussion rooms within the maze.

constraint_statement: The four-plate door is seamless grey stone set flush with the wall, with no hinge or handle, four copper plates, and unusual keyholes beneath the word VALARITAS.
paraphrase: This is not an ordinary locked door but a uniquely built high-security threshold embedded in the Stacks.

constraint_statement: Elodin has an office in Hollows, even though he rarely or never seems to use it.
paraphrase: Hollows contains at least one master office in addition to its admissions functions.

constraint_statement: A Haven guard estimates roughly 320 to 350 patients are present, with room for another 150 if needed.
paraphrase: Haven is a truly large institutional complex, not a small ward or annex.

constraint_statement: Alder Whin's Haven room has tall windows, normal furniture, and thick white padding on walls, ceiling, and floor that muffles sound.
quote_excerpt: walls, ceiling, and floor were all padded
paraphrase: At least some Haven rooms are daylight-accessible but heavily customized for patient safety and sound suppression.

constraint_statement: One Haven containment room uses a solid copper door, bare grey stone walls, huge copper-framed windows, no inner handle, a visible balcony without obvious access, and unusual heavy-feeling air.
paraphrase: Haven includes at least one specialized high-containment chamber engineered for dangerous arcanists or namers.
notes: Integrated from evidencNOTW.xlsx. Mechanism behind the heavy-air effect remains unknown.
